claims.claim: Официальный кейтеринг Governor's Ball после Оскара
claims.evidence: NYT (2026-03-13): 'Wolfgang Puck and his team spend months preparing to cater the Governors Ball, the official Oscars after-party.'; ABC News: 'The Oscars after-party will be catered again by famed chef Wolfgang Puck'; WPCatering IG: 'For more than three decades'.

claims.claim: 40+ лет на рынке; Tappan Hill Mansion и Skylark
claims.evidence: Founded 1975 by Abigail Kirsch (Westchester County Hall of Fame) → ~50 years in 2026 (claim '40+' is conservative TRUE). Signature properties page lists both Tappan Hill Mansion (Westchester) and The Skylark (30 stories above Manhattan Fashion District rooftop lounge).

claims.claim: The Plaza Hotel, Jazz at Lincoln Center, Apollo Theater; slogan 'unleash joy through genuine hospitality'
claims.evidence: LinkedIn/Glassdoor/Wollman Park Partners all confirm: 'exclusive caterer to many high-profile NYC institutions including The Plaza Hotel, Jazz at Lincoln Center, Apollo Theater, Brooklyn Museum'. Official Mission (multiple job listings): 'Unleash Joy through Genuine Hospitality'.

claims.claim: Reinventing food as design since 1989
claims.evidence: Official site, Instagram bio, LinkedIn, and Facebook all say verbatim: 'Reinventing food as design since 1989'. NY • MIA • PB • Worldwide.

claims.claim: Colorlib #1 в рейтинге кейтеринговых сайтов
claims.evidence: colorlib.com article '30 Best Catering Website Examples 2026' lists '1. Salthouse Catering' as #1 (followed by Tall Guy and a Grill, Steven's Catering, Creative Edge Parties, Wild Thyme Company). Salthouse is Charleston, SC.

claims.claim: Женевский traiteur
claims.evidence: Yelp: 'Route de Chancy 26, 1213 Petit Lancy, Switzerland'. Site: 'Pommier le Traiteur Rue de la Madeleine 13 1204 Genève'. Tripadvisor listing under Lancy/Geneva. Local.ch confirms Petit-Lancy location.

claims.claim: Один из крупнейших кейтерингов Нью-Йорка
claims.evidence: Official site title: 'One of New York, NY largest Caterers - Lunch wraps, weddings, breakfasts, galas'. Instagram: 'One of the most prominent NYC Caterers'. Located at 20 W 55th St, NYC.

claims.claim: 40+ лет опыта; B Corp™ сертификация
claims.evidence: About page: 'Rooted in a 40 year heritage, we combine luxury and creativity with the modern, sustainable ethos of a B Corp certified organisation'. LinkedIn title: 'By Word Of Mouth | B Corp™'. Facebook/IG: 'creating elegant, beautifully styled events for over 40 years'.

claims.claim: Один из самых титулованных кейтерингов Канады; publishes minimum order
claims.evidence: 'Один из самых титулованных' is reasonable: LinkedIn describes them as 'Toronto's most distinguished catering and events brands'; won ICA 'Best Hors D'œuvre 2024 @icacater'. HOWEVER: 'publishes minimum order' is UNVERIFIED — their official site does not publish a public minimum order amount. A third-party Facebook post mentions '$1300 min spend' but this is not from their site.

claims.claim: Семейный бизнес с 1928 года; 95 лет; эксклюзивный менеджер Mellon Auditorium
claims.evidence: Official site: 'Founded as a family business in 1928'; site footer/header: 'For over 95 years, Ridgewells Catering has been behind the scenes...'; press release: 'Ridgewells Catering Selected as Exclusive Manager for DC's Mellon Auditorium' (took over Nov 1, 2023).

claims.claim: С 1980 года; publishes wedding prices from $120/guest
claims.evidence: 'Since 1980' VERIFIED TRUE (official site + ALBUM agency + PartySlate all confirm). HOWEVER: 'publishes wedding prices from $120/guest' is UNVERIFIED — WeddingWire lists $65 avg per person for hors d'oeuvres; no public $120/guest starting price was found. The company does not appear to publish prices publicly on their own site.

claims.claim: 40+ лет; slogan 'Elegance | Innovation | Seamless Execution'; Главный кейтеринг Bay Area
claims.evidence: Instagram bio verbatim: 'Elegance | Innovation | Seamless Execution • San Francisco Bay Area Preeminent Catering & Events bringing your visions to life for 40+ years'. Facebook same. McCalls SF located at 1798 Bryant St, San Francisco.

claims.claim: chef + designer duo; food furniture
claims.evidence: About page: 'Led by a Chef and Designer duo, Pinch Food Design is a NYC-based catering company creating innovative culinary experiences with bold flavors and artistic...'. Instagram: 'This is the Pinch Table: a modular, flat-packed, lightweight piece of food furniture crafted to keep up with the pace of New York City.'

claims.claim: 20+ лет работает с NYC's finest cultural institutions
claims.evidence: Official site header: 'For over twenty years Olivier Cheng Catering and Events has been creating innovative culinary experiences in New York's finest cultural institutions.' (Note: older LinkedIn page says 'fifteen years' but current site says 'twenty years' — site is authoritative.)

claims.claim: Старейший кейтеринг Франции, основан в 1820 году; 200+ лет истории; Подразделение Accor Group; Banquet des Maires в Tuileries (22 000 гостей в 1900)
claims.evidence: Accor Careers: 'POTEL & CHABOT. Luxury brand since 1820' / 'The Potel & Chabot Group, a subsidiary of the Accor Group'. Wikipedia/Taste of France: 'Two tonnes of salmon, 22,000 guests' at the 1900 Banquet des Maires (Tuileries, 22 Sept 1900). 1820 → 2026 = 206 years (200+ TRUE). NUANCE: 'Старейший кейтеринг Франции' is debatable — sister brand Dalloyau (1682) is older, but Potel & Chabot brand itself dates to 1820.

claims.claim: Event Caterer of the Year по London Venue & Catering Awards; 121 событие в 18 аккредитованных площадках за одно лето
claims.evidence: Instagram: 'Moving Venue has been crowned Event Caterer of the Year at the London Venue & Catering Awards'. London Venue Awards 2025 winners page: 'CATERER OF THE YEAR – over £7m Turnover. Winner: Moving Venue' (official title; company uses 'Event Caterer of the Year' in own PR). Summer 2024 IG: 'catering over 121 events across 18 of our accredited venues in London'. Site: '40 years' history.

claims.claim: Award-winning luxury catering в Dubai и Abu Dhabi

claims.claim: 20+ лет в Dubai
claims.evidence: Official site title verbatim: 'Luxury AHS Catering & Events in Dubai | 20+ Years of Excellence'. About Us page: 'AHS Catering and Events is a leading Dubai catering company with more than 20 years of excellence in luxury weddings, corporate functions, and private...'

claims.claim: Boutique event catering в Сингапуре
claims.evidence: Official site meta description verbatim: 'We are a boutique event catering company in Singapore providing luxury food & catering services on all scales, from home parties to big events.' LinkedIn: 'Amici Events and Catering is a premium bespoke caterer in Singapore'.

claims.claim: Handcrafted French canapés
claims.evidence: Official site meta description verbatim: 'Luxe Catering offers handcrafted French canapés and luxury catering in Singapore for corporate events, private dining, and elegant celebrations.'

claims.claim: Каталонский премиум-кейтеринг
claims.evidence: Artigot Catering is MADRID-based, NOT Catalan. Founded in Madrid (Polígono de Julián Camarillo). esmadrid.com (Turismo Madrid) official page: 'Founded in 2012, Artigot Catering has been a Great Company since 2023'. They serve Barcelona/Catalonia for events but are headquartered in Madrid. The claim 'Каталонский' should be corrected to 'Мадридский' (Madrid-based) or 'Испанский премиум-кейтеринг с офисом в Мадриде'.

claims.claim: 32 локации в 12 странах на 3 континентах
claims.evidence: Official site: 'We offer Gourmet Entertainment all over the world. We operate 32 locations in 12 countries on 3 continents, maintaining the highest standard of quality in both our products and services. AT-1010 Vienna Worldwide'. LinkedIn: same wording. NOTE: brand is officially 'DO & CO' (not just DOCO); HQ is Vienna, Austria — so this is an AUSTRIAN company, adding Austria to the country list.
